instruction: Convert form.docx located on the desktop to a PDF file named form.pdf and place it on the desktop.

args.query: title = 'form.pdf' or title = 'form.docx' or title = 'form.docx.pdf' or title = 'forms'

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting the form.docx file to PDF format and saving it on the desktop as form.pdf. The evaluator checks if the PDF file exists at /home/user/Desktop/form.pdf and contains the expected key text from the original document (Flagstaff Unified School District, Functional Behavior Assessment, ABC Data Assessment Form). Custom getter get_desktop_pdf__a45ebe2876987410607711d3992c10db retrieves the PDF from the desktop, and custom metric check_desktop_pdf__a45ebe2876987410607711d3992c10db validates the file exists, has proper size, and contains all three key phrases.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies file location: getter retrieves PDF from /home/user/Desktop/form.pdf matching instruction requirement
Content validation is semantically appropriate: metric checks key phrases from source document to ensure actual conversion occurred, not just file existence
Complete coverage: evaluator checks both file existence (location + name) and content integrity (3 key phrases from form.docx)
Partial credit logic is reasonable: returns matches/total ratio, allowing detection of partially successful conversions
Edge cases handled correctly: metric handles None return from getter, checks file size (>10KB) to prevent empty/corrupt PDFs, and catches exceptions during PDF reading
Data flow is logically correct: getter extracts PDF file -> metric validates size and extracts text -> checks key phrases are present
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Getter return type is Optional[str] while metric first parameter expects str, but metric correctly handles None at runtime with 'if not result' check, so no functional issue

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_desktop_pdf__a45ebe2876987410607711d3992c10db first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_desktop_pdf__a45ebe2876987410607711d3992c10db return type (Optional)
